explanation: Kilometer, Liter, Kilogram, and Kelvin are all units from the metric system (or closely associated with SI). Acre is a unit of area from the imperial system.

category: The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: All tokens except 'Great Wall of China' are traditionally considered part of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Great Wall is not on this traditional list; it is often considered one of the New7Wonders of the World.
Ate (eight), See (C), Eye (I - Roman numeral for one), and Know (no/zero) are homophones for numbers. Sew is not a homophone for any number.
